📖 How to Use This File

This is a single, fully offline tool that combines everything in one file — the New Connection estimate / proposal generator and the Maintenance Work / Underground (UG) Cable Work calculators. Open it straight from your computer or phone; no internet or installation is needed.

The tabs at the top are grouped by colour: New Connection (Printable Estimate → Sketch), Maintenance / UG (Maint. Entry, Annexure-1, UG Cable Work), and Data / Tools (Cost Data, Editable Rates, Register, Instructions).

1. Normal New Connection (LT/HT, Load Extension, Line Shifting, etc.)

  1. Go to the 📝 Entry tab and choose the connection type under "Proposal For."
  2. Fill in the applicant's Name, Address, Village, Tariff, and Load.
  3. Fill in Sub Division, Division Office, and Circle once — the file remembers these in your browser, so you won't need to retype them next time. A "Clear Saved" link is available if you want to change Sub Division, Division and Circle.
  4. Add the required Part A / Part B items from the pickers as needed.
  5. Open the Main Estimate Sheet tab to see the finished estimate, then switch to Proposal, Technical Sanction, Office Note, and No Due Certificate — each fills in automatically from what you entered.
  6. On the Main Estimate Sheet tab, print directly, or use 📄 Export Word to save a copy outside the browser.

2. Maintenance Work & Underground (UG) Cable Work

The Maintenance Work Annexure-1 total and the UG Cable Work total flow into the Printable Estimate automatically and live — there is no push, send, or refresh step. Just fill the tabs and the Estimate updates itself.

  1. Open the 📋 Maint. Entry tab and enter each work item and quantity. The 📊 Annexure-1 tab shows the calculated material + labour cost as you go.
  2. On the Annexure-1 tab, every auto-calculated quantity can be overridden — each row has a "+Adj. Qty" box to add or subtract from the system figure; totals update immediately. Items not in the standard list can be added by hand via "➕ Additional Material / Labour Lines."
  3. For underground cable, open the 🔌 UG Cable Work tab and fill the Selection Panel.
  4. Each of these tabs has an Entry / Calculation view and a Printable view — use the small buttons at the top of the tab to switch between them.
  5. Go to the Main Estimate Sheet tab. The figures are already there:
    • Part A gets a single line "Installation of 11KV UG [size] sqmm , [Single/Double Cable]" = the UG Cable Work grand total.
    • Part D gets a single line "Misc. Material and Labour as Per Annexure-1" = the Annexure-1 grand total.
  6. Both flow through to the Proposal, Technical Sanction, and Office Note automatically.
Everything is one file and fully live: edit a quantity on any Maintenance or UG tab, return to the Printable Estimate, and the Part A / Part D figures are already updated.

3. Starting Fresh — "🗑️ Clear All"

The "🗑️ Clear All" button next to Print on the Printable Estimate tab wipes all the current entries — applicant details, Part A / B / augmentation / custom lines, the Sketch, and the Maintenance & UG work — so you can begin a new proposal from scratch. It asks for confirmation first. Two things are deliberately kept safe: your saved Register (all logged proposals) and your remembered Sub Division / Division / Circle.

4. Technical Sanction — D.O.P. Clause by Scheme

On the Technical Sanction, the D.O.P. (Committee Level) clause is chosen from the Scheme. The ND scheme and the ND-equivalent schemes SPA, TASP, DZ, KJ, ZP, SCSP, AG SC all use clause 1.2; any other scheme uses clause 1.3. Just type the correct scheme name on the Estimate form and the Technical Sanction copy updates itself.

5. Exporting & Records

  • 📄 Export Word — saves a Word file (.doc) with the same A4 page setup, letterhead and tables as the printed sheet.
  • 📊 Register tab — click "Add Current Proposal to Register" after finishing an estimate to log it as a row with its full data attached; export the full list as CSV any time to keep a running record. Re-open that CSV with "Import CSV" another day (or on another computer) and click "↩ Load" on any row to bring that exact proposal back, fully filled in. Note: "🗑️ Clear All" never touches the Register.

6. A Few Things Worth Knowing

  • Everything runs locally in your browser — no data ever leaves your computer or phone.
  • Saved Sub Division / Division / Circle and the Register list live in this browser, on this device — they won't follow the file if you copy it elsewhere or open it on a different machine, and clearing the browser's site data will remove them. Export the Register CSV to carry your records across devices.
  • It's a single self-contained file — keep one master copy and share copies as needed.
Hope this file helps the Field office in their day-to-day work. It works on your mobile phone too.
